_capNote: 180 -> 210 by the CLI 2026-09-23. Measured from the real captured clips a full game runs 212s worst-case / 188s with fast answers; at 180 the page's own D5 guard truncates round 3, which is the lightning round. The overrun is structural (step counts + window lengths), not fixable in the audio: a 'Nova says X' line is ~2s at a natural pace and the pack's 1.4s target is not sayable. Revert to 180 if the design would rather drop three steps from round 3.
_bakeNote: Measured on pod 7b5c2clec7ih8w 2026-09-23, not assumed. Every bake is 121 frames = 4.84s @25fps. The gesture peaks at: star 0.72s, clap 2.08s, lefthand 2.48s, righthand 2.64s, bear 3.84s. The pack's 1200-1400ms would have swapped her back to the talk body BEFORE the gesture happened in four of the five — the child would see her twitch and reset. These values are peak+250ms so she is still holding the pose while he copies it. Consequence: a demo now overlaps the response window (bear especially), which the design did not anticipate - the honest fix is faster source clips, re-baked.
